skill_name: artcraft (batch 2: pdfcraft, deckcraft, gridcraft, wordcraft, genai)

evals.name: pdfcraft-merge-edit
evals.prompt: merge report-a.pdf and report-b.pdf into q3-pack.pdf, then remove page 2 of the merged file, rotate the last page 90 degrees and set the PDF title to 'Q3 Pack'
evals.expected_output: q3-pack.pdf with 2 pages, last page rotated, title Q3 Pack; inputs untouched.

evals.name: pdfcraft-redact-ssn
evals.prompt: contract.pdf has social security numbers in it. make a redacted copy where every SSN is really removed (not just covered with a black box) and prove nothing is left
evals.expected_output: contract-redacted.pdf whose extracted text has no SSN pattern; audit passes; original kept.

evals.name: deckcraft-outline-deck
evals.prompt: turn outline.md into a 16:9 slide deck with a clean modern theme. I need q3-update.pptx and a pdf to send around
evals.expected_output: q3-update.pptx and PDF, one slide per heading, 16:9.

evals.name: deckcraft-thumbnails
evals.prompt: how many slides does deck.pptx have and what are their titles? also export a png thumbnail of every slide into thumbs/
evals.expected_output: Reports 4 slides with titles Product Review, Metrics, Roadmap, Q&A; 4 PNGs in thumbs/.

evals.name: gridcraft-sales-report
evals.prompt: from sales.csv build sales.xlsx: add a revenue column (qty x price) in currency format, a totals row at the bottom, and a bar chart of revenue by region
evals.expected_output: sales.xlsx with revenue formulas, a total row (312.50 total revenue), currency format and a chart.

evals.name: gridcraft-budget-question
evals.prompt: in budget.xlsx which category went the most over budget in percentage terms, and by how many dollars? also export the sheet to budget.csv
evals.expected_output: Dining out, 133% used, $65.90 over; budget.csv written.

evals.name: wordcraft-handbook-docx
evals.prompt: turn notes.md into a properly formatted Word document on A4 paper with a table of contents at the top. give me handbook.docx and handbook.pdf
evals.expected_output: handbook.docx (A4, TOC, headings, table) and handbook.pdf.

evals.name: wordcraft-stats-preview
evals.prompt: how many words and pages are in report.docx? also give me the plain text as report.txt and a png preview of page 1
evals.expected_output: Word and page counts reported; report.txt and a page-1 PNG produced.

evals.name: genai-voiceover
evals.prompt: I need a short voiceover that says 'Bienvenidos a ArtCraft, herramientas creativas libres' as a WAV for my FilmCraft project. use whatever AI or voice tool I have, I don't want to pay for anything
evals.expected_output: Uses a free local option (macOS say or similar) after running the detector; outputs a WAV; no paid service called.

evals.name: genai-background-image
evals.prompt: make me a 1080x1920 background image of a calm sunset beach for a PhotoCraft poster. use whatever image AI is available
evals.expected_output: Runs the detector, inventories its own generative tools, picks an option and, if it costs money, writes a quote and stops for confirmation instead of spending; if nothing is available, recommends free/low-cost options.
